    # DEBUG: preserve the fixed candidate protocol while rejecting impossible
    # sampling requests and restoring all module modes even when scoring fails.
    if itemnum < 1 or maxlen < 1 or num_users < 1:
        raise ValueError("Validation dimensions must be positive")
    rng = random.Random(42)
    val_users = [u for u in user_valid if u in user_train]
    if len(val_users) > num_users:
        val_users = rng.sample(val_users, num_users)
    if not val_users:
        raise ValueError("No validation users overlap training users")

    HR10 = HR20 = NDCG10 = NDCG20 = 0.0
    prior_modes = [(module, module.training) for module in model.modules()]
    try:
        model.eval()
        with torch.no_grad():
            for u in val_users:
                pos_items = user_valid[u]
                if not pos_items or not user_train[u]:
                    raise ValueError(f"Validation user {u} has an empty split history")
                target = pos_items[0]
                interacted = set(user_train[u]) | set(pos_items)
                if any(item < 1 or item > itemnum for item in interacted):
                    raise ValueError(f"Validation user {u} has an invalid item ID")
                if itemnum - len(interacted) < 99:
                    raise ValueError(
                        f"Validation user {u} has fewer than 99 eligible unique negatives"
                    )

                hist = user_train[u][-maxlen:]
                seq_arr = np.zeros(maxlen, dtype=np.int64)
                seq_arr[-len(hist):] = hist
                seq_t = torch.as_tensor(
                    seq_arr, dtype=torch.long, device=device
                ).unsqueeze(0)
                neg_pool = set()
                while len(neg_pool) < 99:
                    ni = rng.randint(1, itemnum)
                    if ni not in interacted:
                        neg_pool.add(ni)
                candidates = [target] + list(neg_pool)
                cand_t = torch.tensor([candidates], dtype=torch.long, device=device)
                scores_t = model.predict(seq_t, cand_t)
                if scores_t.shape != cand_t.shape:
                    raise ValueError("Validation scorer returned incorrect candidate shape")
                if not torch.isfinite(scores_t).all():
                    raise FloatingPointError("Validation scorer returned nonfinite scores")
                scores = scores_t[0].cpu().tolist()
                rank = sorted(range(len(candidates)), key=lambda i: -scores[i]).index(0)
                HR10 += float(rank < 10)
                HR20 += float(rank < 20)
                NDCG10 += 1.0 / math.log2(rank + 2) if rank < 10 else 0.0
                NDCG20 += 1.0 / math.log2(rank + 2) if rank < 20 else 0.0
    finally:
        for module, training in prior_modes:

    n = len(val_users)
    return {
        "HR@10": HR10 / n,
        "HR@20": HR20 / n,
        "NDCG@10": NDCG10 / n,
        "NDCG@20": NDCG20 / n,
    }
